free_tier.stated: 20 GB per attached video (official FAQ post: 'Вы можете прикреплять к постам видео размером до 20 ГБ'). Community reports the effective limit was cut to 1 GB at one point (2025-07 post: 'Бусти ограничили ... до 1 ГИГА').

interface_detail: Web + a reverse-engineered API (community downloaders exist: ath31st/boosty_downloader).
chaining: 20 GB is attractive but only for video, and video is transcoded — so the ingest number does not translate into storage of arbitrary bytes.
limits_note: per-object-cap 20 GB, video only. Video is re-encoded for the internal player (their own announcement of the 'Внутренний видеоплеер'), so originals are not what gets served — rule 4 disqualifier.
reliability_note: Re-encodes at ingest (rule 4: podcast/video hosts that re-encode do not return your bytes). Limit has been reduced unilaterally at least once, which is a retention-clamp risk.
